attribution_limitations: Impella access site: the case text says the device was inserted via a graft on the left subclavian artery, while the Figure 3 caption says the graft is on the left axillary artery. The two arterial names are kept as printed and not reconciled.

Troponin print differences: the text gives high sensitivity troponin-I as 18 509 ng/L with reference range 0–58, while Table 1 gives 18 509.6 ng/L with reference range 0.0–0.58. This is treated as a rounding and decimal-point print difference; the table cell is used and the text is not treated as a second value.
D-dimer unit: the text prints 2296 ng/L (reference 0–230) while the Table 1 row label is ng/mL. The unit is left null on the D-dimer facts, which are review_only; no unit is chosen.

First Table 1 column is labelled "On admission" while the text introduces the same Table 1 values as results on arrival in the ICU. The table column label is used as the time and the text label is recorded here; it is not stated whether admission means the local hospital or the cardiac centre.

Creatinine 109 μmol/L, ALT 1088 IU/L and AP 110 U/L in the late-course text paragraph match Table 1 "After 14 days" numerically, but the result sentences state no time of their own (the "from Day 14" of the preceding sentence names end-organ dysfunction, not these tests), the text does not tie them to Table 1, and the ALT unit differs (IU/L in text, U/L in table). They are kept as separate time-free facts and not merged.

Cardiac index 3.2 L/min/m^(2), CVP 8 and PCWP 13 appear in the Day 4 timeline row and, with units, in the text sentence on the pulmonary artery flotation catheter; the text sentence states no day, so the two are kept as separate facts and not merged.

Duration of the first prone episode: the abstract says the patient was nursed prone overnight, while the case text says proned for 24 h. The case text value is used for the duration fact; the abstract wording is not recorded as a second duration.

Authors discuss whether SARS-CoV-2 infection was nosocomial (only the second BAL sample was positive) or primary at presentation; they state they feel the evidence indicates primary infection at presentation. The condition is recorded as confirmed COVID-19 without an acquisition-setting attribute.

Source conflict with the supplementary slide set (ytaa342_supplementary_data.zip, PPTX): the slide set names a different antiplatelet drug before LAD stenting than the tirofiban stated in the article. Both sides are review_only; drug identity is not resolved.

Source conflict with the supplementary slide set: the slide set states a different day of death than the article, which prints a timeline day for refractory multiorgan failure and death and places the death in the third week in the abstract. The article day is kept only on a review_only fact; the death event carries no time.

Timeline table day cells: in the Day 1 and Day 6 groups the following rows have empty first cells (rowspan 1), so they carry no stated day of their own. No day was assigned to those rows or to events matched with them.

The abstract describes complete recovery of neurological function after a short period of agitation, while the case text later reports a worsening neurological state during the final week. The statements concern different phases and are both kept.

claims.text: A 43-year-old male smoker with no prior medical history or current medication presented to a local hospital with severe central chest pain after three days of intermittent chest discomfort and pyrexia.
